summary: CRITICAL retest PASSED. The Admin ProjectForm 422 regression is fully resolved by the toBL() coercion in useState + updateProject-then-close pattern. End-to-end verified via UI: login → Projects → Edit 'harmony-business-centre-kottayam' → Media tab → toggle Design OFF → Save = HTTP 200, modal closes, public /projects/harmony-business-centre-kottayam correctly omits project-tab-design; toggle back ON → Save = HTTP 200, public page restores all 5 tabs (story/design/delivery/media/partners). Monochrome rebrand introduced NO functional regressions: all 7 public routes (Home, About, Services, Projects, CaseStudy, Ecosystem, Contact) return 200 with zero pageerror events, dark navbar renders with data-testid=navbar-desktop-nav and all 6 nav items present. Contact enquiry submit → POST /api/leads = 201, success UI (Enquiry Received) displayed. Backend phase6 pytest suite: 8/8 passed. Older phase2/3/4/5 test files fail only because they don't load frontend/.env (BASE_URL empty) — pre-existing test-scaffold issue, not a regression; every individual test passes when env is exported. No auth issues, no overlay issues, no console errors on public pages.

minor.issue: Do not call load_dotenv('/app/frontend/.env'); BASE_URL='' when running via bare pytest, producing MissingSchema errors. Only test_phase6 loads it correctly. Not a product bug — test-scaffold hygiene.

issues: Legacy hydration warnings about <span data-ve-dynamic> being an invalid child of <thead>/<tr>/<tbody>/<select>/<option>. Non-functional (emergent instrumentation), pre-existing since iteration_7/8.

action_items: (Optional/hygiene) Update legacy test files (test_phase2/3/4/5/septa_api.py) to include `from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('/app/frontend/.env')` before reading REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, matching the phase6 test file — so `pytest backend/tests/` works as a whole regression suite without needing manual env export.
(Optional) Investigate/suppress legacy <span data-ve-dynamic> instrumentation hydration warnings in admin tables (cosmetic console noise).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectForm.jsx L20 toBL() correctly normalizes legacy string title/short_description/challenge to {en, ml:null}. Fix is minimal and correct.

ProjectsTab.jsx L126 uses updateProject(...).then(setEditing(null)) so the modal only closes on successful PUT — good; on 4xx the async chain rejects and the ProjectForm's alert('Error saving project') fires. Consider surfacing server error messages (422 detail) into the alert for better admin UX.

Backend ProjectUpdate schema still requires BilingualText for title/short_description/challenge. Frontend normalization handles it, but adding a Union[str, BilingualText] validator on backend would harden the API against any other callers/legacy imports.

Public site: monochrome rebrand is purely presentational (className remap + font swap); no functional/side-effect changes observed. Navbar data-testid attributes (navbar-desktop-nav, navbar-nav-item-{key}, navbar-get-quote-button, navbar-logo-link) present and stable for automation.

success_rate.backend: 100% on the relevant phase6 suite (8/8). Older suites pass individually; group-run failures are test-scaffold env loading, not product bugs.
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the retested critical flows: admin edit+save (200), public tab visibility toggle end-to-end, all public pages loading with no JS errors, contact form submit (201).

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST lead (name='TEST Regression User', phone=+919999888877) via public /api/leads to verify submit flow — DELETED via DELETE /api/leads/{id} (status 200) after test. harmony-business-centre-kottayam tab_visibility.design was toggled OFF then restored to ON — final state is fully restored (all 5 tabs visible on public page).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_8 blocking bug (Admin ProjectForm 422 on legacy bilingual strings) is fixed and re-verified in iteration_9. The monochrome rebrand is confirmed non-regressive. If regressions re-appear, first run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase6_tabvis_bulkhide_ml.py (loads env correctly). For UI, use data-testid selectors: admin-email-input/admin-password-input/admin-login-btn → tab-projects → edit-project-{slug} → project-form-tab-media → project-tab-vis-{story|design|delivery|partners} → save-project-btn. Legacy phase2..5 tests need `load_dotenv('/app/frontend/.env')` prepended before BASE_URL read — main agent may batch-patch these for cleaner CI.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — critical bug from iteration_8 confirmed resolved. Root cause was: ProjectForm useState hydrated legacy DB string values (project.title, project.short_description, project.challenge) verbatim into form state, but ProjectUpdate Pydantic schema required BilingualText dicts → 422. Fix in place: `const toBL = (v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? { en: v, ml: null } : (v || { en: '', ml: null }));` applied to title/short_description/challenge in the state initializer (ProjectForm.jsx L20-35). Verified via UI PUT returning 200 and modal closing cleanly.
